source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Chapter 1 (PDF 4-21), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 1 (Measurements) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har 5 number ke theory sawal (definition, wazahat, derivation) ke baad usi mauzu ka 3 number ka numerical hai. Har sawal ka model jawab hai; numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 What are base and derived quantities? Describe the two steps involved in the measurement of a base quantity. Name the seven base quantities of SI with their units and symbols. (5 marks)
(Base aur derived quantities kya hain? Base quantity ki measurement ke do qadam bayan karein. SI ki saat base quantities un ke units aur symbols ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Base quantities: Woh aazad (independent) physical quantities jin ki madad se baqi tamam quantities define hoti hain. Yeh khud kisi aur quantity se define nahi hotin. Misaal: length, mass aur time.

Derived quantities: Woh quantities jo base quantities par munhasir (depend) hain, maslan velocity, acceleration aur force.

Base quantity naapne ke do qadam:
1. Aik standard (miyar) chunna.
2. Naapi jane wali quantity ko standard se mawazna (compare) karne ka tareeqa tay karna, taa ke us quantity ki peemaish aik number aur aik unit ki shakal mein mil jaye.

Measurements qabil-e-aitbaar (reliable) aur durust (accurate) honi chahiye taa ke asaani se aur kaamyabi se istemal ho sakein.

SI ki saat base quantities (Table 1.1): neeche table mein hain.

book_ref.quote: The measurement of a base quantity involves two steps

blocks.prompt:
2 The length, breadth and thickness of a glass sheet are 2.65 m, 1.20 m and 0.85 cm respectively. Calculate its volume correct up to the appropriate significant figures. (3 marks)
(Sheeshe ki aik sheet ki lambai 2.65 m, chaurai 1.20 m aur motai 0.85 cm hai. Us ka volume durust significant figures tak nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Teeno peemaishein aik hi unit mein le kar zarb dein; jawab mein utne hi significant figures rakhein jitne sab se kam durust factor mein hain.

book_ref.quote: The length, breadth and thickness of a metal sheet are 2.03 m, 1.22 m and 0.95 cm respectively.

steps: Factor 0.85 cm mein sab se kam significant figures (do) hain, is liye volume 2 significant figures tak likha jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
3 What is the System International (SI)? Write any eight conventions (rules) for using SI units. (5 marks)
(System International (SI) kya hai? SI units istemal karne ke koi aath usool (conventions) likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
SI: 1960 mein aik international committee ne physical quantities ke liye definitions aur standards par ittefaq kiya. Is nizaam ko System International (SI) kehte hain. Is mein base units aur derived units hain aur yeh saari scientific dunya aur taqreeban har mulk mein istemal hota hai.

SI units ke usool:
1. Har unit ka symbol hota hai, abbreviation (mukhaffaf) nahi, maslan "A" na ke "amp", "s" na ke "sec".
2. Unit ka poora naam capital letter se shuru nahi hota (newton, metre), siwaye Celsius ke.
3. Symbols chhote (lower case) huroof mein hote hain (m, s), siwaye litre ke "L" ke.
4. Scientists ke naam par symbols ka pehla harf capital hota hai: N, Pa, W.
5. Symbols ki jama (plural) nahi banti: 1 kg, 60 kg.
6. Symbol ke baad full stop nahi lagta, siwaye jumle ke aakhir mein.
7. Prefix unit se pehle baghair space ke likha jata hai: mL, ms.
8. Do prefix ikatthe (compound prefixes) mana hain: 1 µµF ko 1 pF likhein.
9. Solidus (m/s) ki jagah negative index (m s⁻¹) likhein.
10. Symbols aur naam mila kar na likhein: metre per second ya m s⁻¹, metre/sec nahi.

book_ref.quote: Use of SI units require special care, more particularly in writing prefixes.

blocks.prompt:
4 Using prefixes and powers of ten, express: (i) 3 km² in m² (ii) 0.000045 s with a suitable prefix (iii) 58000 g in kg (iv) 5 µµF in the correct SI form. (3 marks)
(Prefixes aur powers of ten se likhein: (i) 3 km² ko m² mein (ii) 0.000045 s ko munasib prefix ke saath (iii) 58000 g ko kg mein (iv) 5 µµF ko durust SI shakal mein.)
blocks.explanation: Prefix wale unit par power poore multiple par lagti hai; prefixes Table 1.3 se lein; do prefix ikatthe mana hain.

book_ref.quote: Compound prefixes are not allowed

blocks.prompt:
5 Why does every measurement have some uncertainty? Explain absolute, fractional and percentage uncertainty, taking the measurement of the length of a book with a metre rule as an example. (5 marks)
(Har measurement mein kuch uncertainty (ghair-yaqeeni) kyun hoti hai? Metre rule se kitab ki lambai naapne ki misaal se absolute, fractional aur percentage uncertainty samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Wajah: Har instrument par aik sab se chhota nishan (smallest division) hota hai aur yeh us ki durusti ki had muqarrar karta hai. Reading qareeb tareen nishan tak li jati hai, is liye har naapi gayi quantity mein kuch uncertainty hoti hai.

Absolute uncertainty: Instrument ki aik sab se chhoti division ke barabar zyada se zyada uncertainty. mm wale metre rule par yeh 1 mm (0.1 cm) hai, jo us ka least count hai.

Misaal: kitab ka aik kinara 10.0 cm aur doosra 33.5 cm ke nishan par hai. Har reading mein ±0.05 cm uncertainty hai:
(33.5 ± 0.05) cm − (10.0 ± 0.05) cm = (23.5 ± 0.1) cm
Yani asal lambai 23.4 cm aur 23.6 cm ke darmiyan hai.

Fractional uncertainty = Absolute uncertainty / Naapi gayi value

Percentage uncertainty = (Absolute uncertainty / Naapi gayi value) × 100

book_ref.quote: You can estimate the maximum uncertainty as being one smallest division of the instrument.

blocks.prompt:
6 On a metre rule graduated in millimetres, one end of a rod is at the 4.0 cm mark and the other at the 26.8 cm mark. Find the length of the rod with its absolute, fractional and percentage uncertainty. (3 marks)
(mm wale metre rule par rod ka aik sira 4.0 cm aur doosra 26.8 cm ke nishan par hai. Rod ki lambai absolute, fractional aur percentage uncertainty ke saath nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Har sire ki reading mein ±0.05 cm hai; minus karne par absolute uncertainties jama ho kar 0.1 cm ban jati hain.

book_ref.quote: It means that the true length of the book is in between 23.4 cm and 23.6 cm.

blocks.final_answer: ℓ = (22.8 ± 0.1) cm; fractional uncertainty 0.004; percentage uncertainty 0.4%

blocks.prompt:
7 What are significant figures? Write the rules for counting significant figures and the rules for rounding off a number. (5 marks)
(Significant figures (ahmiyat wale hindse) kya hain? Significant figures ginne ke usool aur kisi number ko round off karne ke usool likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Significant figures: Kisi measurement mein durust maloom hindse aur pehla andaze wala (mashkook) hindsa significant figures kehlate hain. Yeh istemal hone wale instrument ko zahir karte hain; ibhaam (ambiguity) se bachne ke liye nateeja scientific notation mein likhna behtar hai.

Ginne ke usool:
1. 1 se 9 tak tamam hindse significant hain.
2. Do significant hindson ke darmiyan zero significant hai.
3. Significant hindson ke baayen (left) zeros significant nahi (0.00467 mein teen hain).
4. Decimal fraction mein significant hindse ke daayen (right) zeros significant hain (3.570 mein chaar). 8000 kg jaise integer mein yeh instrument ki precision par munhasir hai.
5. Scientific notation mein power of ten ke ilawa tamam hindse significant hain (8.70 × 10⁴ kg mein teen).

Round off ke usool:
1. Agar hatne wala pehla hindsa 5 se kam ho to aakhri baqi hindsa waisa hi rehta hai.
2. Agar 5 se zyada ho to baqi rehne wala hindsa aik barh jata hai.
3. Agar hatne wala hindsa 5 ho to pichhla hindsa taaq (odd) ho to aik barhta hai, juft (even) ho to waisa hi rehta hai (73.650 → 73.6; 64.350 → 64.4).

book_ref.quote: The number of digits of a measurement about which we do feel reasonably sure are called significant figures.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Odd/even ka usool yaad rakhein: 5 hatane par pichhla hindsa sirf tab barhta hai jab woh odd (1, 3, 5, 7, 9) ho. Is tarah bohat si readings mein round off barabar oopar neeche hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
8 Round off each of the following to three significant figures: (i) 36.45 (ii) 28.75 (iii) 0.004568 (iv) 7.4932. Write (iii) in scientific notation. (3 marks)
(In sab ko teen significant figures tak round off karein: (i) 36.45 (ii) 28.75 (iii) 0.004568 (iv) 7.4932. (iii) ko scientific notation mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Hatne wala pehla hindsa dekhein; agar 5 ho to odd/even ka usool lagayein.

book_ref.quote: If the digit to be dropped is 5, the previous digit which is to be retained is increased by one if it is odd and retained as such if it is even.

steps: (i) 36.45: hatne wala hindsa 5 hai aur us se pehla (4) even hai, is liye waisa rehta hai: 36.4
(ii) 28.75: hatne wala hindsa 5 hai aur us se pehla (7) odd hai, is liye barhta hai: 28.8
(iii) 0.004568: shuru ke zeros significant nahi; hatne wala pehla hindsa 8 hai (5 se zyada): 0.00457 = 4.57 × 10⁻³
(iv) 7.4932: hatne wala pehla hindsa 3 hai (5 se kam): 7.49

blocks.prompt:
9 State and explain with examples the rules for significant figures in the result when numbers are (i) multiplied or divided (ii) added or subtracted. Why must the calculator answer be rounded off? (5 marks)
(Misalon ke saath bayan karein ke nateeje mein significant figures ke kya usool hain jab numbers ko (i) zarb ya taqseem (ii) jama ya tafreeq kiya jaye. Calculator ka jawab round off karna kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Zarb ya taqseem: Hasil-e-zarb ya hasil-e-taqseem mein significant figures sab se kam durust factor (jis mein sab se kam significant figures hon) se zyada na rakhein.
Misaal: (5.348 × 10⁻² × 3.64 × 10⁴) / 1.336 calculator par 1.457… × 10³ aata hai. Factor 3.64 × 10⁴ mein teen significant figures hain, is liye jawab 1.46 × 10³ hai.

(ii) Jama ya tafreeq: Jawab mein decimal ke baad utne hindse rakhein jitne sab se kam decimal places wali quantity mein hain. Yahan significant figures ki tadaad nahi, decimal ki jagah ahem hai.
Misaal: kitab mein metres jama karne ki pehli misaal mein 72.1 m ke decimal ke baad sab se kam (aik) hindsa hai, is liye majmooa 75.5 m tak round hota hai.

Thumb rule: Jama/tafreeq: barabar precision. Zarb/taqseem: barabar accuracy (barabar significant figures).

Calculator ka jawab: Calculator chip jitne hindse de sakti hai deta hai. Faltu hindse parhne wale ko dhoka de sakte hain, is liye aakhri jawab durust significant figures tak round off kiya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The number of decimal places retained in the answer should be equal to the smallest number of decimal places in any of the quantities being added or subtracted.

blocks.prompt:
10 Give each answer to the correct significant figures or precision. (i) Evaluate (4.236 × 10⁻² × 2.51 × 10³) / 1.48 to the correct number of significant figures. (ii) A bag measured by a lever balance has mass 2.48 kg. Two coins of 5.02 g and 5.03 g measured by a beam balance are put in it. Find the total mass to the appropriate precision. (3 marks)
(Har jawab durust significant figures ya precision tak dein. (i) (4.236 × 10⁻² × 2.51 × 10³) / 1.48 ko durust significant figures tak hal karein. (ii) Lever balance se naapa gaya thaila 2.48 kg ka hai. Beam balance se naape gaye 5.02 g aur 5.03 g ke do sikke us mein dale jate hain. Kul mass munasib precision tak nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: (i) Zarb aur taqseem: sab se kam significant figures faisla karte hain. (ii) Jama: sab se kam decimal places faisla karte hain; pehle grams ko kilograms mein badlein.

book_ref.quote: Keep a number of significant figures in the product or quotient not more than that contained in the least accurate factor

steps: 2.51 aur 1.48 mein teen significant figures hain (sab se kam), is liye jawab mein teen: 71.8 = 7.18 × 10¹
2.48 kg (sab se kam precise) ke decimal ke baad do hindse hain, is liye kul mass do decimal places tak likha jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
11 What is meant by precision and accuracy of a measurement? Explain with the example of a metre rule and Vernier Callipers which reading is more precise and which is more accurate. Why should a smaller quantity be measured with a more precise instrument? (5 marks)
(Measurement ki precision aur accuracy se kya muraad hai? Metre rule aur Vernier Callipers ki misaal se samjhayein ke kaun si reading zyada precise aur kaun si zyada accurate hai. Chhoti quantity ko zyada precise instrument se kyun naapna chahiye?)
blocks.explanation:
Precision: Yeh istemal hone wale instrument se tay hoti hai. Least count (absolute uncertainty) jitna chhota, measurement utni zyada precise.

Accuracy: Measurement ka asal ya maani hui (accepted) value ke qareeb hona. Yeh fractional ya percentage uncertainty se zahir hoti hai; yeh jitni kam, measurement utni zyada accurate.

Misaal:
Metre rule (least count 0.1 cm): lambai = 25.5 cm
Percentage uncertainty = (0.1 / 25.5) × 100 = 0.4%
Vernier Callipers (least count 0.01 cm): lambai = 0.45 cm
Percentage uncertainty = (0.01 / 0.45) × 100 = 2%

Is liye metre rule wali reading kam precise magar zyada accurate hai (kam percentage uncertainty), jab ke Vernier wali reading zyada precise magar kam accurate hai. Asal ahmiyat nisbati (relative) measurement ki hai.

Quantity jitni chhoti ho, instrument utna precise hona chahiye: 0.45 cm ko micrometer screw gauge (least count 0.001 cm) se naapna chahiye tha.

Thumb rule: Precision: kam absolute uncertainty. Accuracy: kam percentage uncertainty.

book_ref.quote: The precision of a measurement is determined by the instrument or device being used.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Aasan yaad: precision instrument ki 'baareeki' hai (least count), accuracy nateeje ki 'durusti' hai (percentage uncertainty). Chhoti cheez ko mota instrument naapega to percentage uncertainty barh jayegi.

blocks.prompt:
12 The length of a table is measured as 32.4 cm with a metre rule (least count 0.1 cm), and the thickness of a coin as 0.62 cm with Vernier Callipers (least count 0.01 cm). Find the percentage uncertainty of each reading and state which is more precise and which is more accurate. (3 marks)
(Metre rule (least count 0.1 cm) se mez ki lambai 32.4 cm aur Vernier Callipers (least count 0.01 cm) se sikke ki motai 0.62 cm naapi gayi. Har reading ki percentage uncertainty nikalein aur batayein kaun si zyada precise aur kaun si zyada accurate hai.)
blocks.explanation: Precision absolute uncertainty (least count) se, aur accuracy percentage uncertainty se parkhi jati hai.

book_ref.quote: Thus, the reading 25.5 cm taken by metre rule is although less precise but is more accurate having less percentage uncertainty or error.

steps: Metre rule: percentage uncertainty = (0.1 cm / 32.4 cm) × 100 = 0.31% ≈ 0.3%
Vernier Callipers: percentage uncertainty = (0.01 cm / 0.62 cm) × 100 = 1.6% ≈ 2%
Vernier wali reading ki absolute uncertainty kam (0.01 cm) hai, is liye woh zyada precise hai.
Metre rule wali reading ki percentage uncertainty kam hai, is liye woh zyada accurate hai.
blocks.final_answer: Vernier wali reading (0.62 cm) zyada precise; metre rule wali reading (32.4 cm, 0.3%) zyada accurate

blocks.prompt:
13 How is the uncertainty of a reading shown on a digital instrument? How do significant figures indicate the uncertainty of a recorded value? State the thumb rules for the uncertainty in the average of many readings and in a timing experiment. (5 marks)
(Digital instrument ki reading mein uncertainty kaise zahir hoti hai? Significant figures kisi likhi gayi value ki uncertainty kaise batate hain? Bohat si readings ke average aur timing experiment ki uncertainty ke thumb rules likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Digital instruments: Hum yaqeeni hindson se aik hindsa aage andaza lagate hain; digital scale par yeh aakhri hindse ke upar neeche hone (fluctuation) se zahir hota hai.
• Agar aakhri hindsa 1 ya 2 tak badle to woh aakhri hindsa likh lein.
• Agar taqreeban 2 se zyada badle to reading par kisi cheez, maslan hawa ke jhonkon (air currents), ka asar ho sakta hai; zyada fluctuation ka matlab hai ke dikhaya gaya hindsa asal mein significant nahi.

Significant figures aur uncertainty: Agar measurement significant figures ko samajh kar likhi jaye to us ka aakhri hindsa, jo andaza hai, likhi gayi value ki accuracy batata hai. Samjha jata hai ke likhe gaye number ke aakhri hindse mein kam az kam 1 unit uncertainty hai (electronic balance ka 3.145 g lever balance ke 3.1 g se zyada accurate hai).

Uncertainty ke thumb rules:
• Bohat si readings ka average: uncertainty average value se mean deviation (ausat inhiraaf) hai.
• Periodic uncertainty (timing experiment): timing device ke least count ko oscillations ki tadaad se taqseem karein.

book_ref.quote: Some modern measuring instruments have a digital scale.

blocks.prompt:
14 The time for 20 oscillations of a simple pendulum is measured as 32.4 s with a stopwatch of least count 0.1 s. Find the time period of the pendulum with its uncertainty. (3 marks)
(Least count 0.1 s wali stopwatch se simple pendulum ki 20 oscillations ka waqt 32.4 s naapa gaya. Pendulum ka time period us ki uncertainty ke saath nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Periodic uncertainty: stopwatch ke least count ko oscillations ki tadaad se taqseem karein.

book_ref.quote: Divide least count of timing device by the number of oscillations.

steps: Time period T = kul waqt / oscillations ki tadaad = 32.4 s / 20 = 1.62 s
T mein uncertainty = least count / oscillations ki tadaad = 0.1 s / 20 = 0.005 s
Period ko us ki uncertainty wali decimal jagah tak likha jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
15 How is the total uncertainty in a final result assessed? Explain the rules for (i) addition and subtraction (ii) multiplication and division, with one example each. (5 marks)
(Aakhri nateeje mein kul uncertainty kaise nikali jati hai? (i) jama aur tafreeq (ii) zarb aur taqseem ke usool aik aik misaal ke saath samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Calculation ke tamam factors ki uncertainties maloom hon to aakhri nateeje ki zyada se zyada uncertainty yun nikalti hai.

(i) Jama aur tafreeq: Absolute uncertainties jama ki jati hain.
Misaal: x₁ = 15.4 ± 0.1 cm aur x₂ = 25.6 ± 0.1 cm
x = x₂ − x₁ = 10.2 ± 0.2 cm
Isi tarah ℓ₁ = 8.5 ± 0.1 cm aur ℓ₂ = 12.6 ± 0.1 cm se ℓ = ℓ₁ + ℓ₂ = 21.1 ± 0.2 cm.

(ii) Zarb aur taqseem: Percentage uncertainties jama ki jati hain.
Misaal: R = V/I jahan V = 3.4 ± 0.1 V aur I = 0.68 ± 0.05 A
V mein percentage uncertainty = (0.1 / 3.4) × 100 = 3%
I mein percentage uncertainty = (0.05 / 0.68) × 100 = 7%
R mein kul percentage uncertainty = 3 + 7 = 10%
R = 3.4 V / 0.68 A = 5.0 ohm, yani R = 5.0 ± 0.5 ohm.
Uncertainty sirf andaza hai, is liye aik significant figure tak likhi jati hai.

book_ref.quote: Knowing the uncertainties in all the factors involved in a calculation, the maximum possible uncertainty or error in the final result can be found as follows:

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab is jagah current ki uncertainty 0.5 A chhaapti hai; I = 0.68 ± 0.05 A se yeh 0.05 A hai. Is liye hum ne 0.05 likha hai (kitab ka jawab 7% bhi isi se nikalta hai).

blocks.prompt:
16 A potential difference V = 4.5 ± 0.1 V across a resistor drives a current I = 0.90 ± 0.05 A through it. Find the resistance R = V/I with its uncertainty. (3 marks)
(Aik resistor par potential difference V = 4.5 ± 0.1 V hai aur us mein current I = 0.90 ± 0.05 A hai. Resistance R = V/I us ki uncertainty ke saath nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Taqseem mein V aur I ki percentage uncertainties jama karein, phir kul ko absolute uncertainty mein badlein.

book_ref.quote: Hence, total percentage uncertainty in the value of R is 3 + 7 = 10%

steps: V mein percentage uncertainty = (0.1 V / 4.5 V) × 100 = 2.2%
I mein percentage uncertainty = (0.05 A / 0.90 A) × 100 = 5.6%
Absolute uncertainty = 5.0 ohm ka 7.8% = 0.39 ohm ≈ 0.4 ohm (aik significant figure)

blocks.prompt:
17 Explain the rule for the uncertainty in a quantity that contains a power (power factor). Find, as in the book, the area of cross-section of a cylinder of radius 1.25 cm measured by Vernier Callipers of least count 0.01 cm, with its uncertainty. (5 marks)
(Jis quantity mein power (power factor) ho us ki uncertainty ka usool samjhayein. Kitab ki tarah least count 0.01 cm wale Vernier Callipers se naape gaye 1.25 cm radius ke cylinder ka cross-sectional area us ki uncertainty ke saath nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
Usool: Formula mein kisi quantity ki percentage uncertainty ko us ki power (power factor) se zarb diya jata hai. Uncertainty power se zarb hoti hai, is liye measurement ki precision ki zaroorat barh jati hai.

Misaal: Cross-sectional area A = πr², is liye
A mein percentage uncertainty = 2 × r mein percentage uncertainty

Vernier Callipers (least count 0.01 cm) se radius: r = 1.25 ± 0.01 cm
r mein percentage uncertainty = (0.01 / 1.25) × 100 = 0.8%
A mein kul percentage uncertainty = 2 × 0.8 = 1.6%
A = πr² = 3.14 × (1.25)² = 4.906 cm², 1.6% uncertainty ke saath
4.906 ka 1.6% = 0.08, is liye A = 4.91 ± 0.08 cm²

Kul uncertainty ka thumb rule: Jama/tafreeq: absolute uncertainties jama. Zarb/taqseem: percentage uncertainties jama. Power factor: power × percentage uncertainty.

book_ref.quote: The percentage uncertainty is multiplied by the power factor in the formula.

blocks.prompt:
18 The diameter and length of a brass cylinder measured with Vernier Callipers of least count 0.01 cm are 1.50 cm and 4.25 cm respectively. Calculate its volume and the uncertainty in it. (3 marks)
(Least count 0.01 cm wale Vernier Callipers se peetal (brass) ke cylinder ka diameter 1.50 cm aur lambai 4.25 cm naapi gayi. Us ka volume aur us mein uncertainty nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: V = π(d²/4)ℓ: diameter ki power 2 hai, is liye us ki percentage uncertainty do baar ginein; phir lambai wali jama karein.

book_ref.quote: The diameter and length of a metal cylinder measured with the help of Vernier Callipers of least count 0.01 cm are 1.25 cm and 3.35 cm, respectively.

steps: d mein percentage uncertainty = (0.01 cm / 1.50 cm) × 100 = 0.67%
ℓ mein percentage uncertainty = (0.01 cm / 4.25 cm) × 100 = 0.24%
Absolute uncertainty = 7.507 cm³ ka 1.6% = 0.12 cm³ ≈ 0.1 cm³ (aik significant figure), is liye V decimal ke baad aik hindse tak likha jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
19 What are dimensions of a physical quantity? Write the symbols of the five basic dimensions. Find the dimensions of speed, acceleration and force, and state two uses of dimensions. (5 marks)
(Physical quantity ki dimensions kya hain? Paanch bunyadi dimensions ke symbols likhein. Speed, acceleration aur force ki dimensions nikalein aur dimensions ke do faide likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Dimensions: Length, mass, time, temperature aur electric current jaisi naapi ja sakne wali khususiyaat jin se kisi physical quantity ko bayan kiya jata hai, dimensions kehlati hain. Yeh quantity ki noiyat (qualitative nature) ko bunyadi quantities ki surat mein batati hain.

Bunyadi dimensions: length [L], mass [M], time [T], electric current [A] aur temperature [θ]. Length, gehrai, oonchai, diameter aur light year sab metre mein naape jate hain aur in ki dimension aik hi [L] hai. Yeh paanch is liye chune gaye ke experiment mein asaani se naape jate hain.

Baqi quantities ki dimensions bunyadi dimensions ka majmooa hain:
Speed: [v] = [L]/[T] = [LT⁻¹]
Acceleration (a = Δv/Δt): [a] = [LT⁻¹]/[T] = [LT⁻²]
Force (F = ma): [F] = [M][LT⁻²] = [MLT⁻²]

Dimensions ke faide:
1. Kisi physical equation ki homogeneity (durusti) check karna.
2. Kisi physical quantity ka mumkina formula derive karna.

book_ref.quote: These measurable properties are called dimensions.

blocks.prompt:
20 Check the homogeneity of the equation of motion vf = vi + at, where vi and vf are the initial and final velocities, a is the acceleration and t is the time. (3 marks)
(Harkat ki equation vf = vi + at ki homogeneity check karein, jahan vi aur vf ibtidai aur aakhri velocities, a acceleration aur t waqt hai.)
blocks.explanation: Har term ki dimensions likhein; durust equation mein dono taraf ki har term ki dimensions aik jaisi hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: Correctness of an equation can be checked by showing that the dimensions of quantities on both sides of the equation are the same.

steps: Yani [LT⁻¹] = [LT⁻¹] + [LT⁻¹]: har term ki dimensions [LT⁻¹] hain.
blocks.final_answer: Dono taraf dimensions aik jaisi hain, is liye vf = vi + at dimensionally durust (homogeneous) hai.

blocks.prompt:
21 State the principle of homogeneity. Derive, by dimensional analysis, a formula for the centripetal force on an object moving uniformly in a circle, assuming that it depends on the mass of the object, its speed and the radius of the circle. (5 marks)
(Principle of homogeneity bayan karein. Dimensional analysis se daire mein yaksaan raftar se chalne wali cheez par centripetal force ka formula derive karein, yeh maan kar ke yeh cheez ke mass, us ki speed aur daire ke radius par munhasir hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Principle of homogeneity: Koi equation tab hi durust ho sakti hai jab us ke dono taraf ki quantities ki dimensions aik jaisi hon.

Derivation: Farz karein F mass m, speed v aur radius r par munhasir hai:
F = (constant) mᵃ vᵇ rᶜ ……(i)
Constant ki koi dimension nahi, is liye dimensions mein:
[MLT⁻²] = [M]ᵃ [LT⁻¹]ᵇ [L]ᶜ = [Mᵃ Lᵇ⁺ᶜ T⁻ᵇ]
Dono taraf powers ka mawazna:
M: a = 1
T: −b = −2, is liye b = 2
L: b + c = 1, is liye c = −1
Yeh (i) mein rakhne se: F = (constant) m v² r⁻¹ = (constant) mv²/r

Constant ki numerical value dimensional analysis se nahi milti; experiment batate hain ke yeh 1 hai, is liye F = mv²/r.

book_ref.quote: Dimensionality can be used to derive a possible formula for a physical quantity by correct estimation of various factors on which the quantity depends.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Tareeqa yaad rakhein: (1) quantity ko factors ki powers ke zarb ki shakal mein likhein, (2) har taraf dimensions likhein, (3) M, L, T ki powers barabar kar ke a, b, c nikalein.

blocks.prompt:
22 A force F acting for time t changes the velocity of a body of mass m from vi to vf. Show that the relation Ft = mvf − mvi is dimensionally correct. (3 marks)
(Waqt t tak lagne wali force F mass m wale jism ki velocity vi se vf kar deti hai. Sabit karein ke rishta Ft = mvf − mvi dimensionally durust hai.)
blocks.explanation: [F] = [MLT⁻²] le kar baayen taraf aur daayen taraf ki har term ki dimensions nikalein.

book_ref.quote: This shows that dimensions on both sides of equation are the same, therefore, the equation is dimensionally correct.

blocks.final_answer: Dono taraf dimensions aik jaisi hain, is liye Ft = mvf − mvi dimensionally durust hai.

blocks.prompt:
23 Write the limitations of (i) dimensional analysis and (ii) significant figures. Explain with the equation S = ½at² why a dimensionally correct equation may still be wrong. (5 marks)
((i) Dimensional analysis aur (ii) significant figures ki hudood (limitations) likhein. Equation S = ½at² ki madad se samjhayein ke dimensionally durust equation phir bhi ghalat kyun ho sakti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Dimensional analysis ki hudood:
• Dimensional tareeqa yeh nahi bata sakta ke equation kahan ghalat hai.
• Agar equation durust sabit ho bhi jaye to bhi hum sirf yeh keh sakte hain ke shayad durust ho, kyun ke yeh tareeqa kisi numerical factor ya constant ko check nahi karta.
• Aise constants sirf experiment se ya variables ke darmiyan munasib graph bana kar maloom hote hain.

Misaal: Rest se chalne wali gaari ke liye S = ½at². Dimensions mein [S] = [a][t²] se [L] = [LT⁻²][T²] = [L], yani equation dimensionally durust hai. ½ jaise numerical factors ki koi dimension nahi, is liye nazar-andaaz ho jate hain; S = at² ya S = 2at² bhi yahi check paas kar lein gi, halaan ke sirf S = ½at² durust hai.

(ii) Significant figures ki hudood:
• Significant figures sirf aik zariye ki uncertainty batate hain: scale parhne ki.
• Asal experiment ki uncertainty mein kai cheezein shamil hoti hain, maslan zaati (personal) ghaltiyan aur kabhi chhupi hui systematic ghaltiyan.
• Is liye kul uncertainty us se zyada ho sakti hai jitni measurement ke significant figures batate hain.

book_ref.quote: The dimensional method cannot identify where an equation is wrong.

blocks.prompt:
24 A body starts from rest and moves with acceleration a. Assuming that the distance S it covers depends on a and the time t, derive the relation between S, a and t by dimensional analysis. Can this method give the numerical constant? (3 marks)
(Aik jism rest se chal kar acceleration a se harkat karta hai. Yeh maan kar ke tay kardah faasla S a aur waqt t par munhasir hai, dimensional analysis se S, a aur t ka rishta derive karein. Kya yeh tareeqa numerical constant de sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: S = (constant) aˣ tʸ likhein, dimensions rakhein aur L aur T ki powers ka mawazna karein.

book_ref.quote: Numerical factors like 1/2 have no dimensions, so they can be ignored.

steps: L: x = 1; T: −2x + y = 0, is liye y = 2
Constant ki koi dimension nahi, is liye yeh tareeqa usay nahi nikal sakta; experiment batata hai ke yeh ½ hai.
blocks.final_answer: S ∝ at² (S = ½at²); constant ½ dimensional analysis se nahi nikal sakta.

blocks.prompt:
25 What are derived units? Give five derived units with their symbols in terms of base units. Write any five additional units that SI permits to be used. (5 marks)
(Derived units kya hain? Paanch derived units un ke symbols aur base units ki shakal ke saath likhein. Koi paanch izafi (additional) units likhein jin ke istemal ki SI ijazat deta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Derived units: Woh units jo base units par munhasir hain. 1995 se plane angle (radian) aur solid angle (steradian) ke units bhi derived units mein shamil hain.

Misalein (Table 1.2): neeche table mein hain.

SI jin izafi units ki ijazat deta hai:
1. Zawiye (angle) ke units: degree, arcminute aur arcsecond.
2. Waqt ke units: minute, hour, day aur year.
3. Logarithmic unit bel (aur decibel).
4. Volume ke liye litre aur bare masses ke liye tonne.
5. Atomic mass unit (u) aur electron volt (eV).
Doosre: nautical mile aur knot, acre aur hectare, bar (millibar, kilobar), angstrom aur barn.

book_ref.quote: Derived units are those units which depend on the base units.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab atomic mass unit ka symbol µ chhaapti hai; µ to micro prefix ka symbol hai. Atomic mass unit ka durust symbol u hai, is liye hum ne u likha hai.

blocks.prompt:
26 Using Einstein's equation E = mc², find the energy equivalent to a mass of 2.0 g. Take c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ and write the answer in scientific notation. (3 marks)
(Einstein ki equation E = mc² se 2.0 g mass ke barabar energy nikalein. c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ lein aur jawab scientific notation mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: E = mc² lagane se pehle mass ko kilograms (SI base unit) mein badlein.

book_ref.quote: According to this equation 1 kg mass is actually 9 × 10¹⁶ J energy.
